sections.Profile:
Star Wars Episode I, released by Williams in June 1999 and designed by John Popadiuk, is a four-player game in which players relive scenes from the 1999 Star Wars prequel film. It is the second and last of the two Pinball 2000 games, alongside Revenge From Mars, and like its partner it reflects a video monitor in the head off the playfield glass so the animation appears to sit on the playfield, where the ball hits virtual targets.
